fallbackLink: If the button does not work, open {url}

magicLink.subject: Your Flatpare sign-in link
magicLink.intro: Here is your sign-in link for Flatpare ({host}).
magicLink.expiry: It works once and expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. Open it in the same browser you asked from.
magicLink.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email; nothing happens without the link.

memberRemoved.subject: You were removed from a household on Flatpare
memberRemoved.removed: {name} removed you from their household on Flatpare.
memberRemoved.access: You no longer have access to its apartments, ratings or locations. Your account is unchanged: sign in and you will find an empty household of your own, and any invitation you accept later still works.
memberRemoved.ask: If this is unexpected, the person who removed you is the one to ask.

invitation.subject: {name} invited you to Flatpare
invitation.invited: {name} invited you to compare apartments together on Flatpare.
invitation.signIn: Sign in with {email} and the invitation will be waiting for you. It is valid until {until}.
invitation.ignore: If you were not expecting this, you can ignore this email and nothing will happen.

betaInvite.subject: Your invitation to the Flatpare beta
betaInvite.invited: You are invited to the Flatpare private beta: a shared place to compare apartments with the person you are moving in with.
betaInvite.open: Open the link below, then sign in. The link opens the door for your account.
betaInvite.openUntil: Open the link below, then sign in. The link opens the door for your account and is valid until {until}.
betaInvite.keep: Beta accounts are free; your data and credits are yours to keep and are not taken back when the beta ends.
